off_photocopier.name: Photocopier
off_photocopier.flavor: Jams on a Monday, purely as a matter of tradition.

off_vending_machine.name: Vending machine
off_vending_machine.flavor: Takes your coins thoughtfully, then has a little think.

off_server_rack.name: Server rack
off_server_rack.flavor: Hums quietly, like it knows something you don't.

off_paper_guillotine.name: Paper guillotine
off_paper_guillotine.flavor: Everyone uses it with enormous, slightly theatrical care.

off_label_maker.name: Label maker
off_label_maker.flavor: Somebody labelled the kettle 'kettle'. Fair enough.

off_franking_machine.name: Franking machine
off_franking_machine.flavor: Older than the postcode it lives in, and twice as reliable.

off_fax_machine.name: Fax machine
off_fax_machine.flavor: Last used in 2009 to confirm a sandwich order.

off_laminator.name: Laminator
off_laminator.flavor: Warms up slowly, then laminates anything that stays still.

off_binding_machine.name: Comb binder
off_binding_machine.flavor: Turns twelve loose pages into a Proper Report.

off_paper_folder.name: Letter folder
off_paper_folder.flavor: Folds letters in three with a sort of quiet dignity.

off_microfiche_reader.name: Microfiche reader
off_microfiche_reader.flavor: Shows you the 1974 accounts, in blue, if you lean in.

off_dictaphone.name: Dictaphone
off_dictaphone.flavor: Contains forty minutes of someone saying 'memo to self'.

off_switchboard.name: Telephone switchboard
off_switchboard.flavor: Put you through to Accounts, eventually, with a smile.

off_teleprinter.name: Teleprinter
off_teleprinter.flavor: Chatters away to an office in Leeds. Nobody minds.

off_network_switch.name: Network switch
off_network_switch.flavor: Blinks green to say all is well. It is mostly right.

off_wifi_router.name: Wi-fi router
off_wifi_router.flavor: Switched off and on again more than any other object here.

off_coin_counter.name: Coin counter
off_coin_counter.flavor: Sorts the tea fund into tidy little towers of shame.

off_air_purifier.name: Air purifier
off_air_purifier.flavor: Breathes in the smell of microwaved fish, quite heroically.

off_reception_desk.name: Reception desk
off_reception_desk.flavor: Where visitors wait politely while someone finds a pen.

off_visitor_book.name: Visitor book
off_visitor_book.flavor: Signed in by Mickey Mouse twice a year, in very neat handwriting.

off_desk_bell.name: Reception bell
off_desk_bell.flavor: One ding is a question. Three dings is a complaint.

off_ticket_dispenser.name: Take-a-number stand
off_ticket_dispenser.flavor: Number forty-two is always just popped out for a minute.

off_queue_barrier.name: Queue barrier
off_queue_barrier.flavor: A rope that asks nicely and is, mostly, obeyed.

off_waiting_bench.name: Waiting-room seats
off_waiting_bench.flavor: Three linked chairs. The middle one is nobody's first choice.

off_leaflet_stand.name: Leaflet stand
off_leaflet_stand.flavor: Holds every leaflet the office has ever been sent.

off_suggestion_box.name: Suggestion box
off_suggestion_box.flavor: Contains one suggestion: more biscuits. Noted.

off_lost_property.name: Lost property crate
off_lost_property.flavor: One glove, two umbrellas and a stapler nobody will admit to.

off_cardboard_cutout.name: Cardboard cutout
off_cardboard_cutout.flavor: A life-size Mr Pendleton, from the 1998 open day. He stayed.

off_filing_carousel.name: Filing carousel
off_filing_carousel.flavor: Spins round once and the file you want is round the back.

off_cubicle_divider.name: Cubicle divider
off_cubicle_divider.flavor: Fabric-covered privacy, about as private as a duvet.

off_drawer_pedestal.name: Drawer pedestal
off_drawer_pedestal.flavor: Bottom drawer: crisps, plasters and a tie for emergencies.

off_plan_chest.name: Plan chest
off_plan_chest.flavor: Ten shallow drawers of drawings for buildings that were never built.

off_tambour_cabinet.name: Tambour cabinet
off_tambour_cabinet.flavor: The shutter rolls up with a sound like a small round of applause.

off_meeting_table.name: Round meeting table
off_meeting_table.flavor: Round, so nobody sits at the head. Somebody still does.

off_stacking_chairs.name: Stacking chairs
off_stacking_chairs.flavor: Four chairs that came for the AGM and never left.

off_lectern.name: Lectern
off_lectern.flavor: Makes anyone standing behind it say 'right then' first.

off_kick_stool.name: Kick stool
off_kick_stool.flavor: Rolls about until you stand on it, then holds its ground.

off_footrest.name: Footrest
off_footrest.flavor: Rocks gently. Nobody has ever admitted to using it.

off_sit_stand_converter.name: Sit-stand converter
off_sit_stand_converter.flavor: Raised once, with ceremony. Has been at sitting height since.

off_confidential_bin.name: Confidential waste console
off_confidential_bin.flavor: Locked, slotted and very slightly smug about it.

off_newtons_cradle.name: Newton's cradle
off_newtons_cradle.flavor: Click, click, click, for exactly as long as the phone call.

off_meeting_timer.name: Meeting hourglass
off_meeting_timer.flavor: Fifteen minutes of sand. The meeting takes forty.

off_card_index.name: Card index box
off_card_index.flavor: Every client since 1981, alphabetical, apart from the Smiths.

off_copier_paper_box.name: Box of copier paper
off_copier_paper_box.flavor: Five reams, and heavier than it has any right to be.

off_cash_box.name: Petty cash tin
off_cash_box.flavor: Holds four pounds and a very detailed IOU.

off_desk_blotter.name: Desk blotter
off_desk_blotter.flavor: Covered in doodles of boxes, which seems about right.

off_stamp_carousel.name: Rubber stamp rack
off_stamp_carousel.flavor: PAID, RECEIVED, URGENT and one that just says LOVELY.

off_light_box.name: Tracing light box
off_light_box.flavor: Glows like a small, very serious sunrise.

off_plan_tube.name: Drawing tube
off_plan_tube.flavor: Carried about like a telescope, which helps morale.

off_megaphone.name: Fire warden's megaphone
off_megaphone.flavor: Used once a year to say 'this way, please', very calmly.

off_tea_urn.name: Tea urn
off_tea_urn.flavor: Brought out for training days, and treated with reverence.

off_mail_sort_rack.name: Pigeonhole rack
off_mail_sort_rack.flavor: Twelve pigeonholes, one each, plus 'Misc', which is full.

off_key_cabinet.name: Key cabinet
off_key_cabinet.flavor: Every key is labelled. None of the labels match a door.

off_fire_extinguisher.name: Fire extinguisher
off_fire_extinguisher.flavor: Checked every year by a man called Clive. Never needed.

off_fire_blanket.name: Fire blanket
off_fire_blanket.flavor: Pull the tapes in an emergency. Or to check it's still there.

off_first_aid_box.name: First aid box
off_first_aid_box.flavor: Plasters, a sling and one very old packet of mints.

off_tannoy.name: Tannoy speaker
off_tannoy.flavor: Says 'would the owner of a blue Volvo' about once a decade.

off_clocking_in.name: Clocking-in machine
off_clocking_in.flavor: Ker-chunk. You are officially here. Have a biscuit.

off_pneumatic_tube.name: Pneumatic tube station
off_pneumatic_tube.flavor: Whoosh, thunk. A memo arrives from three floors up.

off_wall_planner.name: Year planner
off_wall_planner.flavor: Holidays in green, deadlines in red, birthdays in cake.

off_award_plaque.name: Employee of the Month plaque
off_award_plaque.flavor: Brenda, eleven months running. The twelfth was a clerical error.

off_staff_photo_board.name: Staff photo board
off_staff_photo_board.flavor: Everyone's photo, taken on the one day they forgot to smile.

off_tea_boiler.name: Wall water boiler
off_tea_boiler.flavor: Gurgles to itself all morning, like a contented radiator.

off_flip_chart.name: Flip chart
off_flip_chart.flavor: Page one says 'Ideas'. Page two is a drawing of a duck.

off_sanitiser_stand.name: Hand gel station
off_sanitiser_stand.flavor: Dispenses one cold blob and a small sense of virtue.

off_wet_floor_sign.name: Wet floor sign
off_wet_floor_sign.flavor: Stands there being right, which is all anyone asks.

off_ink_bottle_set.name: Fountain pen and ink set
off_ink_bottle_set.flavor: Kept for signing things that are Actually Important.

off_ledger_book.name: Cheque book and ledger
off_ledger_book.flavor: Balanced to the penny every Friday, then celebrated with a custard cream.

off_biscuit_rota.name: Biscuit rota board
off_biscuit_rota.flavor: Whose turn it is to buy biscuits, settled in writing at last.

off_postal_sack.name: Mail sack
off_postal_sack.flavor: Royal Mail delivered it full. It will leave full of something else.
